|ewot = wyndera}}'''Wyndera Ovan''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[White Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Wyndera Ovan|Wyndera}}

== Strength ==
[[Covarla Baldene]] obtained command in [[Dorlan]] because she was the strongest of the group that escaped [[Dumai's Wells]]. Therefore, it is likely that Wyndera's strength level is beneath {{opsl|27}}, which is Covarla's level.

== Activities ==
Wyndera remained loyal during the [[Tower]] split. She was sent to [[Cairhien]] to kidnap [[Rand al'Thor]] and escaped Dumai's Wells with Covarla to take refuge in Dorlan.{{ref||Wyndera}}

==Trivia==
This Aes Sedai is described only in "The Wheel of Time Companion", she is never mentioned in the main books of the Wheel of Time.
